about.intro: I lead 3D modeling work and build software for the processes around it. At EMAPTA I managed up to 13 modelers at once and about 50 over the role, while the team sustained roughly 3,000 orders a month. Alongside employed roles, I built a production AppSheet ERP for a design and construction business, contractor wage tools, and custom AI harnesses for development work. My strongest software stack is Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB.

description: Led up to 13 modelers at once and about 50 across the role, covering assignments, training, quality review, deadlines, and client issues.
The team sustained roughly 3,000 modeling orders a month.
Built performance and order tracking tools, SketchUp utilities, and change-based updates across 1,000+ fields to work within Google API limits.
Delivered a production AppSheet ERP connecting leads, sales, design, tenders, construction, project tasks, and daily operations for an interior design and construction business.
Built contractor tools for labourer attendance, daily wages, pay advances, and bonuses.
Built a restaurant menu reflecting the client's visual identity and a commissioned Hangouts-style chat application for a US client.
Produced architectural models and rendered scenes, prepared materials and presentation views, and handled revisions and scene cleanup for delivery.
Created and prepared 3D models for games and contributed Unity programming during a one-year internship.
